title: Relief Ground Share by Reported Separation Reason and Employer Benefit Charging Class
content:
In a determination granting relief on a separation response under Employer Benefit Charging, the relief ground share turns on the separation reason the response on record reports and on what the position's charge class allows.

## Rule

The relief ground share is the whole (1.00) when the response on record reports a voluntary quit, a discharge for misconduct or a refused offer of work and the position's charge class allows relief for that ground; when the response on record reports that the employer still employs the claimant part time and the class allows continuing part-time relief, it is the most recent charge posted over the relief window, the week the response confirms the continuing employment; and zero (0.00) otherwise.

## Matrix

| Reported separation reason | Separating Employer — Most Recent; Base Period Employer — Proportional Share; Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer; Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer; Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar; Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar |
|---|---|---|
| Voluntary quit | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Discharge for misconduct | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Refused offer of work | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Still employed part time | 0.00 | Most recent charge posted over the relief window |
| Lack of work | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Discharge for another reason | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| No reason reported, or no response on record | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The class columns follow the grounds each class allows: the first group allows relief for a voluntary quit, a discharge for misconduct and a refused offer of work, and not continuing part-time relief; the second allows continuing part-time relief and none of those three.

## Points of judgement

- *The response on record* is the employer's separation-response submission on the position; the reason is the separation reason recorded on the position from it.
- *The most recent charge posted* is the amount of the benefit charge with the latest posting date on the position. The fraction is used unrounded; where the relief window holds no charge, the fraction does not arise and the share is zero.
- Hypothetical: a Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar response reports the claimant still employed part time; the relief window holds $600.00 and the most recent charge is $120.00. The relief ground share is 120 over 600, one fifth.
